source.title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)

metric.name: E_framework
metric.movement: NO FROZEN-METRIC MOVEMENT; source-generalization obligation moved materially

method_outcomes.B11: PROGRESS: proved the exact Gibbs variational dual for soft collision pressure and a negatively-associated latent-support theorem. For nonnegative H, Psi_mu(H) <= sum_i p_i(exp(b_i)-1), with b_i=sum_j p_j H_ij (exp(W_j)-1)/W_j; bounded row/column sums recover an O(n p^2) certificate for uniform marginals.
method_outcomes.B24: PROGRESS: solved the exact product-null extremal problem at fixed uniform marginal p. For K_c(S,T)=exp(c|S cap T|), E K=sum_A (exp(c)-1)^|A| P(A subset S)^2; the unique maximizer is the empty/full two-point law, while for np<=1 the empty/singleton law attains the exact first-order minimum. iid Bernoulli is not generally the minimizer.
method_outcomes.B30: PROGRESS: proved exact two-color linked-cluster cancellation and kernelization: only clusters touching both replica colors survive log Z(S,T)+log Z(0,0)-log Z(S,0)-log Z(0,T), and allocating each absolute cluster weight across its red-blue mark pairs yields a soft kernel H_TC. Under a verified rooted tree/KP majorant with bounded H_TC row/column sums, B11 gives an all-order p^2 pressure certificate from local factor tables.

mathematical_state.soft_collision_dual: Psi_mu(H)=sup_{nu<<mu otimes mu}{E_nu[S^T H T]-KL(nu||mu otimes mu)}; event lower bounds quantify collision energy minus latent entropy.
mathematical_state.negative_association_pressure: For NA support law with p_i=P(i in S), W_j=sum_i H_ij and b_i=sum_j p_j H_ij phi(W_j), phi(w)=(e^w-1)/w, Psi_mu(H)<=sum_i p_i(e^{b_i}-1). If row/column sums <=W, rho=max p_i, A=e^W-1, then Psi<=((A/W)e^{A rho}) p^T H p; uniform p gives <=n p^2 A e^{A p}.
mathematical_state.product_kernel_extremal: For a=e^c-1 and q_A=P(A subset S), E exp(c|S cap T|)=sum_A a^{|A|}q_A^2. Uniform marginal p implies maximum 1+p^2(e^{cn}-1), uniquely attained by S=V with probability p and empty otherwise. If np<=1, minimum is 1+(e^c-1)n p^2, attained by empty/singleton support.
mathematical_state.two_color_cancellation: In a common absolutely convergent linked-cluster expansion of the four partition functions, all uncolored, red-only and blue-only clusters cancel exactly; only bichromatic clusters survive. Defining H_TC,ij by distributing |Phi(Gamma)| over r(Gamma)b(Gamma) red-blue pairs gives |Delta(S,T)|<=sum_{i in S,j in T}H_TC,ij.
mathematical_state.tree_majorant: Under a stronger verified tree/KP rooted majorant with connected-step constant C_F and theta=C_F eta<1, a conservative certificate is W_TC<=eta_R eta_B C_F/(1-C_F eta)^2. This is a sufficient standard tree-majorant consequence, not a sharp or novel KP theorem.
mathematical_state.combined_source_condition: Fixed degree-transport tilt s_0 plus a summable soft collision kernel and an NA latent support law with explicit pressure certificate Theta_n=o(D_n) yields degree loss g_n=ceil(Theta_n/(2s_0)+omega_n)=o(D_n) and noised low-degree control through D_n-o(D_n).

prior_art_state: Gibbs/Donsker-Varadhan variational formulas, negative association/strong-Rayleigh/determinantal examples, Kotecky-Preiss/tree-graph/cluster correlation estimates, Dobrushin uniqueness/covariance estimates, Renyi/collision entropy, Kato/Toda/QR, Davies/Combes-Thomas and quasi-local spectral flow are prior art. The product-kernel feature expansion is elementary. Two-color cancellation is a direct classical linked-cluster specialization. Inference synthesis novelty remains UNVERIFIED.
later_negative_stress: Songtao Mao arXiv:2607.20318 remains mandatory and is excluded only through substantive pressure/reference, latent-dependence and transport hypotheses, never by naming the rank distinguisher.

next_attack.B3: Prove a broader sub-Poisson latent collision theorem from a directly checkable Laplace-domination condition, testing strongly-Rayleigh, fixed-size and spatially-mixing latent Gibbs laws.
next_attack.B23: Test whether transport plus pressure plus log-Sobolev/hypercontractive smoothing can upgrade D_n-o(D_n) polynomial indistinguishability to total-variation/noisy statistical indistinguishability on a nonproduct Gibbs class; otherwise isolate an explicit obstruction.
next_attack.B29: Derive a large-deviation variational criterion for exchangeable rare-macroscopic support laws, balancing collision energy against the rate function and unifying iid, negatively-associated sparse and empty/full heavy-tail regimes.
